parsed.name: Specim短波红外高光谱相机
parsed.description: 这是一种短波红外高光谱相机，用于采集样品在短波红外波段的空间-光谱图像数据。实验室中常用于材料表征、成分分析、分选研究和其他需要短波红外成像光谱测量的实验。
parsed.description_en: This is a short-wave infrared hyperspectral camera used to acquire spatial-spectral image data of samples in the SWIR range. In laboratories, it is commonly used for material characterization, composition analysis, sorting studies, and other experiments requiring SWIR imaging spectroscopy.

actions.description: 通知指定的相机属性发生变化或需要更新。
actions.description_en: Notify that a specified camera property has changed or needs updating.
